rows.failed_obligation: From (3/2)^n=2^{k_n}2^{theta_n} with 1≤2^{theta_n}<2, its floor need not equal 2^{k_n}.
rows.minimal_repair_direction: Replace n13 onward with an argument that validly controls the fractional part of (3/2)^n and hence the remainder.
rows.reason: The verified irrational-rotation density theorem validly supplies arbitrarily large n with theta_n>beta, but it does not justify the false floor calculation. For example n=3 gives floor((3/2)^3)=3 while 2^{k_n}=2.
